01 / The real question

SEO / Strategy

Which technical obstacles prevent discovery?

Technical SEO supports crawling, indexing and a good user experience. It does not replace useful content, but removes avoidable technical barriers. We review the website as a system: internal links, redirects, canonicals, status codes, rendering and performance. Verifiable errors matter more than generic optimisation lists.

First the cause. Then the fix.
02 / What we review

Content needs to be reachable before it can have an impact.

We check rendering, redirects, indexing and internal links, prioritising impact over an arbitrary checklist.

  1. 01Crawling and indexing
  2. 02Technical URL consistency
  3. 03Mobile performance and accessibility
03 / Priorities

Find errors.
Fix causes.

We assess the current situation first, then prioritise fixes by impact and risk.

  1. 01

    Review the current site

    Which pages are reachable and indexable, and which are redirected incorrectly or served more than once?

  2. 02

    Prioritise causes

    Rank technical problems by impact, risk and implementation effort.

  3. 03

    Check the results

    Verify fixes with fresh crawls, browser checks and suitable search data.

04 / Recognising quality

A prioritised list instead of generic optimisation.

A prioritised technical foundation that supports content work and makes future regressions easier to detect.

So we can give you a specific answer

  • The affected website or example URL
  • A known error message or audit excerpt without credentials

No account access or passwords required.
